decision.observation: The goose stands at the gate's right post by the watering can. The stone wall begins east of the post; there is grass between the post and the wall that might connect north around the gate.
decision.hypothesis: Walking north on the grass strip just east of the right post may round the gate into the garden side.
decision.memory: Gate latch/lever resists beak grabs; grass strip at x~0.70 between post and wall is the detour candidate.
